title: own_words misses the command words of a shell run with combined flags (bash -ec), after time -p and after timeout N
goal: bl_land.own_words reads the -c string of a shell whose flags are combined with c (bash -ec, sh -xc), skips time's options (time -p) and treats timeout with its options and duration as a prefix runner, so own_failure names a tool missing from the repro's own command (jq: command not found, exit 127) as the repro's own error instead of accepting it as a tool missing inside a wrapper (BG-bapadqdl). Found by the SP-hyp6o7hl review.

run: import sys;sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import bl_land;R=[['bash','-ec','if true; then jq .; fi'],['bash','-c','time -p jq .'],['bash','-c','timeout 5 jq .']];W=[(r,bl_land.own_words(r),bl_land.own_failure(r,127,'bash: line 1: jq: command not found')) for r in R];[print(r,'words',w,'own_failure',f) for r,w,f in W];sys.exit(1 if any('jq' not in w or not f for r,w,f in W) else 0)
